annotations.title: What has happened at a place in the past

description:
What has hit a place before: "has Lisbon had a big earthquake", "how often do typhoons reach Manila", "what floods has Valencia had". Earthquakes, tropical cyclones, tsunamis, floods and eruptions near it: how many by decade and the largest, with date, distance, deaths and damage.

A count is complete only from `complete_from` (quakes of M5 and up 1976, cyclones 1980, floods 2021, and its `note` says so: a rise in floods before then is no trend). Ask for more years to reach the great events: the record goes back to 1700 for those that cost lives. What is happening now: get_hazards_near.

hazards.description: Only these hazards; all five when omitted

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

name: get_place_history

attribution.description: The credit the licence asks for when it is retold

name.description: The feed's name as it is cited

by_decade.description: The count per decade, by the decade's first year

complete_from.description: The year from which the count holds every event of its size; before it, or where null, only those NOAA NCEI lists for what they cost, so a quiet decade there is no evidence of one

count.description: How many came within `radius_km` over the span

note.description: What this count cannot be read for

damage.description: NCEI's class: limited under $1 million, moderate, severe, extreme over $25 million

date.description: When it began; a date NCEI holds only to the year stands at January 1

deaths.description: Deaths on record, where NOAA NCEI lists the event

distance_km.description: How near it came: a storm by its path, anything else by its point

name.description: The event, in its source's words

value.description: Its size in `unit`: magnitude, wind where a storm came nearest, water height, VEI; null where the record holds none

credit.description: How a retelling credits the answer: Source: Criora with a link to the page the answer is about, then each originator whose data it quotes in the words its licence asks for. Concise, each credit once; detailed, by source with its name and licence, criora first

criora_url.description: The place on the Criora map

hazards.description: By hazard: earthquake, cyclone, tsunami, flood, volcano. Wildfire is not an event record here: burned_area in get_climate_profile says how much burns

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given

since.description: The first day of the span
